title: Order confirmation
summary: The confirmation screen after a captured payment: a success check, the paid order number (#1042) with a 'Paid' badge, the payment method + processor reference (pay-1042 / auth_9f2a1042), and the paid line items with the total. Populated by hand from Customer alex-green + the genuinely-paid Order 1042 (monstera-deliciosa, EUR 34). Order 1050 is the open cart used by the cart / declined states, so it is not rendered here as paid. This is the `confirmed` step of both customer-buys-a-plant and the checkout-and-pay child flow.
